name: docxwise
description: Export Obsidian notes to .docx without Pandoc.

scripts.build: node tools/gen-notices.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p . && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.test: esbuild test/license.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/license.cjs --log-level=warning && node out/license.cjs && esbuild test/run.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=out/run.cjs --log-level=warning && node out/run.cjs && python3 test/check.py out/research-apa.docx out/research-chicago-notes.docx out/edge-cases.docx out/long-note.docx out/merged-pro.docx

author: Smallbench Labs
